Stainless Steel 32" x 34" Long Kick Plate

This 32" x 34" Long Kick Plate is made of .050" thick high quality stainless steel. It has a satin stainless steel finish. Packaged with matching brass mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications of the 32" x 34" Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Plate Width: 32"
  • Plate Length: 34"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Made to order. NOT Returnable.
